limitations: This lifecycle applies only to the recorded MUSD NTT generation and must not be applied to Native Bridge.
A successful source receipt is not destination completion.

states.evidence: included source receipt with failure status
successful source receipt with OutboundTransferQueued or OutboundTransferRateLimited
successful source receipt with TransferSent digest and transceiver send evidence
source sent but no conclusive destination evidence
successful destination receipt with provider transceiver receive event
successful destination receipt with InboundTransferQueued and no TransferRedeemed
successful destination receipt with TransferRedeemed for the source NTT digest
conflicting, incomplete, provider-limited, or non-final evidence

transitions.condition: source receipt is included with failure
source receipt succeeds but outbound capacity queues the transfer
source receipt succeeds and emits the NTT transfer digest
no conclusive destination receipt is available
the destination transceiver receives the Wormhole message
the same destination receipt emits TransferRedeemed
a later successful completion receipt emits TransferRedeemed

reconciliationRequirements: Assert source and destination network identity independently.
Retain the source transaction, TransferSent digest, Wormhole emitter tuple when available, destination transaction, and TransferRedeemed digest.
Treat receipt absence and negative scans as unknown unless the selected provider supplies stronger terminal evidence.
Re-read pause, peer, threshold, capacity, recipient, and fee inputs before any future writer call.
Do not collapse Native Bridge states into this NTT model.
